text:
andy_ops: Heads up — vendor updated the EU shipment ETA and there's a paperwork mismatch. H100s batch #B12 now ETA 2026-04-10 to FRA depot, partial split: 18 units air, 6 by sea. AWBs attached below. We have 4 units flagged DOA in manifest; vendor asking if we want RMA pre-auth and whether we can accept them at our on-prem staging or redirect to depot.

marta_supply: Can you paste the AWB list and the serials flagged as DOA? Also need HS code and declared value for customs — finance will block otherwise.

andy_ops: Sure — AWBs:```AWB-PLT: 123-45678901
AWB-AIR-1: 123-45678902
AWB-AIR-2: 123-45678903``` DOA serials: SNL-EX-991, SNL-EX-992, SNL-EX-993, SNL-EX-994. HS: 8471.50. Declared value per unit: $38,000.

logistics-bot: Automated update: AWB-PLT has hit FRA customs hold (status: NEED_DOCS). ETA impact +72h if bond not posted.

zoe_infra: If customs holds, we can't get units into our EU private cluster before the 10th. Also heads-up: FRA depot has reported a mismatch on 2 serials compared to packing list last week — may need depot audit. For on-prem returns we need pre-authorized RMA docs, otherwise depot will quarantine.

ryan_eng: For the 4 DOA units, can we accept them to the rack for immediate diagnostics? If so, we need loaner request for prod-backed capacity (we're already 85% booked this month). If not, vendor should swap before handover.

marta_supply: Finance needs a customs bond approval. @zoe_infra can you confirm if our current carrier can post a temporary bond for AWB-PLT? If not, we escalate to the vendor for consolidated AWB and re-declare value.

lex_nexa: Hi all — Nexa here. Quick clarifications: we can consolidate AWBs if you prefer, and we can pre-authorize RMA for the 4 DOA units with an RMA ID: RMA-8712. We need your approval to route DOAs straight to FRA depot vs on-prem. If you route to on-prem, vendor will not accept liability until we have signed receipt. Also we can provide 4 temporary loaners on 30-day courtesy at no charge, pending return of DOAs.

andy_ops: Thanks Lex. Ops preference: route DOAs to FRA depot (faster customs clearance overall), vendor to issue RMA-8712 and depot to run diagnostics. Approve loaners for 30 days — please send loaner SKU and tracking. Marta, please ping finance for bond. Zoe — confirm carrier capability or we'll ask Lex to consolidate.

marta_supply: Pinged finance — they asked for the invoice PDF and importer tax ID. I requested from Lex.

lex_nexa: Uploaded invoice and declared values to the carrier portal and confirmed they can post a temporary bond for AWB-PLT. Sending consolidated AWB in 2h and loaner AWB ASAP.

zoe_infra: Noted. I'll add a temporary canary allocation for the 4 loaners (limit 3 concurrent jobs) and a monitoring hook for IO/thermal so we can triage remotely. Please add the depot audit task to the ticket — they may need serial reconciliation before release.

andy_ops: Great — final check: anybody object to routing DOAs to FRA depot under RMA-8712 and accepting loaners? :thumbsup: to agree, :thumbsdown: to stop.

ryan_eng: :thumbsup:

marta_supply: :thumbsup:

zoe_infra: :thumbsup:

lex_nexa: :thumbsup: will keep you posted when AWB consolidated and loaners ship.

logistics-bot: Ticket #OPS-4321 updated: RMA-8712 created, AWB consolidation in progress, bond posted.
